explication: CodeGraph indexes a codebase into a connected graph augmented with embeddings, then exposes code-aware retrieval to agents through MCP and CLI tools. The principal workflow is project input → parsing and analysis → graph/embedding persistence → agent query → graph-aware results. The README documents the richer analyzer stages and tiered indexing; sampled source confirms indexing orchestration, parser behavior, chunking/provider interfaces, and SurrealDB storage. Some analyzer, retrieval, and server links are documented or inferred from the module structure rather than inspected implementation.
